title: Page 107
transc:
11 pm Lawrence  Washn July 8th 1864
Sarah for Palate Howe Camel unity Mackerels orchard
expects to reach Hedge ville sharper about federal
spoons torrent of Dagger this evening zebra You
will prepare all your nutmeg saint to take
the field peru Mutton arrives zodiac you will
also assist him in ransoming a steuben Jordan


12 M Beckwith  Washn July 11th 1864
Crowd yard Spark Watkins has just arrived and a
part of his pelton will soon be in stick
He will take tipton until ready for the opinion
pike spit Saco Sumner on the Advent above chain
pilot stop We can give him wayworn but very
little or no Pagoda tulip Please send up his
Pacifics as nearly ready for the opinion as possible
yacht Raven close to our lines on Rock will
weakness whipping with our pedlar & trades tulip His
pekin patron is pretty swimming pike with pagoda &
star behind but how much not ascertained stop Accounts
from Opal indicate that he was badly cut up
tulip Militia repeated from Girdle to Bard delayed by
the Governor for some reason not explained yacht Bergen
will do nothing to help us tulip The Barnard 
has seen your whiff about putting Moscow in Opals
place at Baron but has given me no repeats
on the subject welch Behead oh for a man
